provenBoundary: Real HTTP SVG cache miss and in-flight completion mutate owned local media while coordinator is held/zero. Cached-repeat HTTP200 uses existing bytes without another object request.
sourceFindings: Blobstore resolves MediaFile through ObjectKey.for_row and validates the relative key before dispatch. Keep row identity and validation; do not replace them with file.path.

S3.ensure_local checks an existing regular file before download. download mkdir_p occurs before Req, then size refusal, unique .part write, rename and cleanup. A guard after network receive alone cannot cover earlier directory effects or in-flight ownership.

S3.delete removes cache before its remote DELETE and intentionally returns :ok on a logged remote error. warm_cache does mkdir/copy after successful remote storage receipt. Their ordinary best-effort contracts are distinct from managed settlement and must not silently become proof of physical success.

LocalWrite uses checkout_effect and the pending-delete database lock, retains uncertain error/unverified effects, and binds original local keys. Reusing it for cache misses would also hold the table lock through network I/O and mark even controlled download errors uncertain after its started marker. This tradeoff needs explicit review; do not casually wrap every read.

Door.admit settles controlled error tuples normally. It is insufficient by itself for uncertain physical effects after owner death. Cache and native rendition work need physical-effect settlement, not only HTTP preflight admission.

MediaController.serve_svg currently collapses every ensure_local error into media blob missing404. A managed refusal must be distinguishable from actual absence; decide and test its status/envelope without changing ordinary bucket404 semantics.
requiredProof: Existing cache read remains usable while held and makes no directory/cache mutation or object request.
Held or unavailable coordinator refuses an absent-cache fill before mkdir/network/write; no file or .part artifact appears.
An open admitted cache miss remains counted until all local effects settle. A concurrent hold waits; it cannot report clean held/zero before the response, write, rename and required cleanup finish.

Owner death, interrupted write/rename/cleanup and lost acknowledgement leave recoverable uncertain evidence rather than a false clean drain. Test real Windows filesystem and restart, preserve originals and partials.
Pending-delete address reservations and NTFS aliases cannot be bypassed by a cache fill at the same owned path. Preserve ordinary non-managed behavior and row-to-object identity.

Retain ordinary S3 exact bytes, cached hit, bucket404, size cap, MIME/SVG/CSP and remote-error contracts. Use real loopback network for effect timing; Req.Test alone cannot prove streaming cancellation.
Rendition deletion/generation and native children remain separate callers to cover; do not mark a full census after repairing only ensure_local.
